values.zh-CN: 带拉格朗日余项的泰勒定理

content.snl: thm-hyp(list-partial(Type.annotation(@F, Analysis.PFun), Type.annotation(list-partial(@x, @y), Real), Type.annotation(@N, Nat), $#0 < #1$(y, x)), Logic.exists-typed(@z, Real, Logic.and(Set.mem(z, Ioo(y, x)), Eq(Type.apply(Analysis.map(F), y), Add.add(Type.apply(Analysis.map(Analysis.taylorPoly(F, x, N)), y), Div.div(Mul.mul(Type.apply(Analysis.map(Analysis.nthDiff($#0 + 1$(N), F)), z), Power(Sub.sub(y, x), $#0 + 1$(N))), $\left(#0 + 1\right)!$(N)))))))

values.en:
Under `(N+1)`-fold differentiability on the interval between the base point and the evaluation point, the remainder has the closed form `F⁽ᴺ⁺¹⁾(ξ)/(N+1)! · (x − x₀)ᴺ⁺¹` for some intermediate `ξ`.

Unlike the Peano form this is a statement at a fixed distance, and it is what yields concrete error bounds once `F⁽ᴺ⁺¹⁾` is bounded. It generalises `BasicAnalysis.thm.lagrangeMVT`, which is the case `N = 0`. The interval hypothesis is directional, so the left and right cases are stated separately.
values.zh-CN:
若在基点与求值点之间的区间上 `(N+1)` 次可导，则余项具有闭式 `F⁽ᴺ⁺¹⁾(ξ)/(N+1)! · (x − x₀)ᴺ⁺¹`，其中 `ξ` 是某个中间点。

与佩亚诺形式不同，这是一个关于固定距离的陈述；一旦 `F⁽ᴺ⁺¹⁾` 有界，它便可给出具体的误差界。它推广了 `BasicAnalysis.thm.lagrangeMVT`，后者是 `N = 0` 的情形。区间假设具有方向性，因此左右两种情形分别陈述。
